mapper.sql: a.id, a.type, a.name, a.description, a.enabled, a.updated_at, link.tag_id
mapper.select: SELECT , a.content FROM assets a LEFT JOIN asset_tags link ON link.asset_id = a.id WHERE a.id = #{id} ORDER BY link.tag_id
SELECT type FROM assets WHERE id = #{assetId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assets (id, type, name, description, content, enabled, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{type}, #{name}, #{description}, #{content}, #{enabled}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE assets SET name = COALESCE(#{asset.name}, name), description = COALESCE(#{asset.description}, description), content = COALESCE(#{asset.content}, content), enabled = COALESCE(#{asset.enabled}, enabled), updated_at = MAX(updated_at + 1, #{now}) WHERE id = #{asset.id}
UPDATE assets SET updated_at = MAX(updated_at + 1, #{updatedAt}) WHERE id IN (SELECT asset_id FROM asset_tags WHERE tag_id = #{tagId})
